simple.meaning: פְּרָזִי (pᵉrâzîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a rustic.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H6521. perazi מְּרָזִי noun [masculine] hamlet-dweller ; — collective with article הַמּ ׳כֹּפֶר 1Sam 6:18 (opposed to מִבְצָר עִיר ), הַמּ ׳עָרֵי Deut 3:5 (opposed to וגו חוֺמָה בְּצֻרֹת ׳עָרִים ); plural הַמְּרָזִים Est 9:19 Qr (Kt הפרוזים ).

occurrences.englishText: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a good day, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.
